name: E2E Flow Tests
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-flows.yml'
      - 'apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**'
      - 'packages/cli/src/**'

env:
  E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED: true
  NODE_VERSION: '20.x'
  PNPM_VERSION: '8'

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
          run_install: false

      - name: Get pnpm store directory
        id: pnpm-cache
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "STORE_PATH=$(pnpm store path)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup pnpm cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.STORE_PATH }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Setup ngrok tunnel
        uses: ngrok/ngrok-github-action@v3
        with:
          authtoken: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          tunnels: |
            proto:http
            addr:3000
            subdomain:inboxzero-e2e

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: |
          pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          E2E_NGROK_TUNNEL_URL: ${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.url }}
          E2E_AI_PROVIDER: openai
          E2E_AI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_AI_API_KEY }}

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: |
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/results/
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/screenshots/
